history.summary: A 3,110sqft freehold 4BR in Pasir Ris (D18) at $3.39M — the $1,089 PSF looks cheap only because the unit is enormous. Far from MRT (1.27km), $3.39M ticket, and a deep-OCR location combine to a very thin exit pool despite a respectable 5.0%/yr resale rate.
history.rating_rationale: This is the classic oversized-unit-disguised-as-cheap-PSF trap. The headline $1,089 PSF sits below the $1,341 median, but 3,110sqft means a $3.39M absolute price in OCR Pasir Ris — well above the liquid band and with a tiny, family-only buyer pool. 1.27km to Elias MRT (15-min walk) hurts both rental and resale. Freehold and 5.0%/yr (47 txns) are positives, but the exit risk at this size/price/location is the dominant factor for an investment hold.
red_flags: $3.39M ticket far above the deep buyer band in an OCR district
3,110sqft oversized unit — cheap PSF masks high absolute price and narrow exit
Built 2006, 20yr old — higher maintenance, dated finishes
catalysts: CRL connectivity arriving in the wider Pasir Ris/Tampines area (~2030)
5.0%/yr resale appreciation on a reliable 47-txn series
